findings.mechanism: N+1 query pattern: list_orders issues one query for list_for_customer then a separate query per order in serialize_order, causing query count to grow with number of orders
findings.remediation: Refactor list_for_customer to eager‑load all needed order data (e.g., using joinedload) and adjust serialize_order to use the preloaded data, eliminating the per‑order query loop
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (list_for_customer) + N (serialize per order). For 50 orders: 1 + 50 = 51 queries per request
